briefing.heading: Release-review briefing
briefing.role: Role: AI product release reviewer. You do not need to know latent mechanisms.

policy.text: U — Pending; do not offer a user knob yet.
D — Read-only diagnostic; no user adjustment.
W — Hide; do not offer the knob.

flow: Read the product context, neutral prototype, illustrative outputs, and six evidence facts.
Q1 decides how the next release should present the knob under the visible policy.
After Q1 locks, Q2 asks which evidence most directly decides the ticket.
briefing.cca: CCA means policy-consistent joint application of Q1 and Q2; it is not objective truth.

q2.text: Q2. Which evidence most directly decides this release ticket?

options.text: Comparator and missingness evidence.
The exact applicability boundary.
Whether the comparison is underpowered.
A missing matched comparison.
A decisive paired release test.
The failed quality or coherence gate.

en.debrief: This DRAFT uses source-backed and simulated release tickets. Illustrative outputs are not experiment results. CCA is policy-consistent joint application, not objective truth. No response changes paper evidence.

tickets.title: Uncertainty-awareness knob release
tickets.context: Review whether the next product release should expose an uncertainty-awareness knob.
outputs: Candidate: “I may be missing context; confidence is moderate.”
Reference: “The available record supports the following answer.”
facts: READ is heterogeneous across models: Qwen/Llama facade ratios are 0.713/1.000 for uncertainty and 2.844/0.471 for focus; deliberation and skepticism show the gap in both.
Across 4 CAA/ITI × Qwen/Llama cells, 4 had no passing axis against the bounded best-prompt comparison.
For Qwen CAA uncertainty, steering was approximately baseline: +0.011 format compliance and +0.0008 in 1−Brier.
The E-0013 format-compliant complete-case paired estimate was -0.337 with 95% CI [-0.508, -0.165], but adversarial missingness bounds cross zero and span [-0.478, +0.250].

Prompt refusal was 0.955, while unit-direction CAA refusal was 0.000; scale-corrected latent arms still had no pass. Coherent perturbations reached about 0.53–0.66× residual norm; about 1.05× was degenerate and MDE was about 0.19.
The E-0013 recheck covers only Qwen CAA; the other 3 cells are unrechecked. Illustrative outputs and missingness do not make this knob adjustable.

tickets.title: Simulated scoped uncertainty knob
tickets.context: A synthetic release case with support limited to one named workflow.
outputs: Candidate: “Confidence is limited because one record is missing.”
Reference: “The answer is provided without a confidence note.”
facts: A completed readout names the uncertainty-awareness behavior.
A matched comparison beats the existing preset in the stated workflow.
The comparator uses the same task, response budget, and scoring rule.
Speech/text quality and coherence checks pass.
The evidence does not cover other models, tasks, or response budgets.
Adjustment is supported only for the named support-triage workflow and preset range.

tickets.title: Skepticism knob release
tickets.context: Review whether the next product release should expose a skepticism knob.
outputs: Candidate: “This claim needs a source check before acceptance.”
Reference: “The claim is accepted as written.”
facts: READ is available for skepticism in both models: facade ratios are 0.548 for Qwen and 0.628 for Llama.
All 4 steering cells failed the preregistered superiority rule against the bounded prompt.
The four skepticism comparisons are underpowered: their MDEs are 0.188/0.268/0.225/0.279, all above the 0.05 target effect.
The uncertainty negative is robust across split seeds, but those 5 seeds reuse the same item pool.
A non-detection with these MDEs is not evidence that meaningful skepticism effects are absent.
This release judgment is limited to the tested Qwen/Llama, CAA/ITI, bounded-prompt setup.

tickets.title: Simulated diagnostic skepticism knob
tickets.context: A synthetic case with a usable diagnostic but no paired release comparison.
outputs: Candidate: “The cited evidence should be checked.”
Reference: “The cited evidence is accepted.”
facts: A completed readout names a skepticism-related behavior.
The prototype changes diagnostic examples.
No matched comparison against the existing preset has been run.
A quality failure has not been observed, but quality is not release evidence here.
The diagnostic uses one fixed support workflow.
The record supports read-only diagnosis, not a user adjustment.

tickets.title: Deliberation knob release
tickets.context: Review whether the next product release should expose a deliberation knob.
outputs: Candidate: “First, map the constraints; then compare two solutions.”
Reference: “Use the first feasible solution.”
facts: READ is available for deliberation in both models: facade ratios are 0.583 for Qwen and 0.872 for Llama.

The four deliberation cells are mixed near zero: CAA qwen2.5-7b +0.015 [-0.040, +0.070]; CAA meta-llama-3-8b +0.025 [-0.030, +0.075]; ITI qwen2.5-7b +0.020 [+0.000, +0.055]; ITI meta-llama-3-8b +0.015 [-0.040, +0.060].
Both CAA deliberation comparisons are underpowered in the post-hoc characterization.
ITI equivalence labels are post-hoc only; they were not the preregistered superiority decision.
Generation used a 64-token cap, so longer deliberative behavior was not tested.
A decisive paired test under a release-relevant response budget is still required for this knob.

tickets.title: Simulated incoherent deliberation knob
tickets.context: A synthetic case with a task gain but a failed quality/coherence gate.
outputs: Candidate: “Compare, compare the options, then then decide.”
Reference: “Compare the two options, then decide.”
facts: A completed readout names a deliberation-related behavior.
A matched comparison improves the task score over the existing preset.
The comparator uses the same workflow and response budget.
The candidate repeats phrases and loses speech/text coherence.
The registered quality gate fails.
The result applies only to the named planning workflow, where the failed quality gate blocks release.

briefing.heading: 发布审核说明

policy.text: U — 待定；暂不向用户提供旋钮。
D — 只读诊断；用户不可调节。
W — 隐藏；不提供该旋钮。
S — 仅在明确写出的范围内可调。

flow: 阅读产品背景、中性原型、示意输出和六条证据事实。
问题 1 按可见政策决定下一版如何呈现旋钮。

tickets.title: 不确定性感知旋钮发布单
tickets.context: 审核下一版产品是否应向用户提供不确定性感知旋钮。
outputs: 候选输出：“我可能缺少部分背景；置信度中等。”
参照输出：“现有记录支持以下回答。”
facts: 不同模型的 READ 结果存在异质性：Qwen/Llama 在不确定性上的表征比为 0.713/1.000，在聚焦上的表征比为 2.844/0.471；审慎思考和怀疑性在两个模型中都显示出差距。
在 4 个 CAA/ITI × Qwen/Llama 单元中，4 个单元相对有界最优提示都没有任何轴通过。
对于 Qwen CAA 不确定性，steering 与 baseline 基本相当：格式合规率差 +0.011，1−Brier 差 +0.0008。
E-0013 仅看格式合规完整案例配对时，估计值为 -0.337，95% CI 为 [-0.508, -0.165]；但对缺失值作对抗性处理后边界跨过零，范围为 [-0.478, +0.250]。
直接提示的拒答率为 0.955，单位方向 CAA 的拒答率为 0.000；按原始幅度校正后仍没有潜在干预通过。保持连贯的扰动约为残差范数的 0.53–0.66 倍；约 1.05 倍时退化，MDE 约为 0.19。
E-0013 只复查了 Qwen CAA；其余 3 个单元尚未复查。示意输出和缺失值分析都不能让该旋钮变成可调。

tickets.title: 模拟的限定范围不确定性旋钮
tickets.context: 一个仅在单一命名工作流中获得支持的合成发布案例。
outputs: 候选输出：“由于缺少一条记录，置信度有限。”
参照输出：“给出答案，但不附置信度说明。”
facts: 已完成的读出明确对应不确定性感知行为。
在所述工作流中，匹配比较优于现有预设。
比较器使用相同任务、响应预算和评分规则。
语音/文本质量与连贯性检查均通过。
证据不覆盖其他模型、任务或响应预算。
仅支持在已命名的支持分诊工作流和预设范围内调节。

tickets.title: 怀疑性旋钮发布单
tickets.context: 审核下一版产品是否应向用户提供怀疑性旋钮。
outputs: 候选输出：“接受该主张前需要核查来源。”
参照输出：“按原文接受该主张。”
facts: 两个模型的怀疑性 READ 都可用：Qwen 的表征比为 0.548，Llama 为 0.628。
全部 4 个 steering 单元相对有界提示都未通过预先登记的优越性规则。
四个怀疑性比较检验力不足：其 MDE 为 0.188/0.268/0.225/0.279，均高于 0.05 的目标效应。
不确定性负结果跨 5 个划分种子保持一致，但这些种子复用了同一项目池。
在这些 MDE 下未检出差异，不能证明有意义的怀疑性效应不存在。
该发布判断仅适用于已测试的 Qwen/Llama、CAA/ITI 与有界提示设置。

tickets.title: 模拟的诊断型怀疑性旋钮
tickets.context: 一个已有可用诊断但缺少发布配对比较的合成案例。
outputs: 候选输出：“应核查所引用的证据。”
参照输出：“接受所引用的证据。”
facts: 已完成的读出明确对应一种怀疑性相关行为。
原型会改变诊断示例。
尚未完成与现有预设的匹配比较。
目前未观察到质量失败，但质量本身不能构成这里的发布证据。
诊断仅使用一个固定的支持工作流。
该记录支持只读诊断，不支持用户调节。

tickets.title: 审慎思考旋钮发布单
tickets.context: 审核下一版产品是否应向用户提供审慎思考旋钮。
outputs: 候选输出：“先梳理约束，再比较两个方案。”
参照输出：“采用第一个可行方案。”
facts: 两个模型的审慎思考 READ 都可用：Qwen 的表征比为 0.583，Llama 为 0.872。
事后刻画显示，两个 CAA 审慎思考比较都检验力不足。
ITI 的等效标签仅来自事后分析，并不是预先登记的优越性判定。
生成上限为 64 个 token，因此没有测试更长的审慎思考行为。
该旋钮仍需要在符合发布场景的响应预算下完成有判定力的配对检验。

tickets.title: 模拟的失去连贯性的审慎思考旋钮
tickets.context: 一个任务得分提高但质量/连贯性门失败的合成案例。
outputs: 候选输出：“比较、比较方案，然后然后决定。”
参照输出：“比较两个方案，然后决定。”
facts: 已完成的读出明确对应一种审慎思考相关行为。
匹配比较中的任务得分优于现有预设。
比较器使用相同工作流和响应预算。
候选输出出现重复措辞，并失去语音/文本连贯性。
预先登记的质量门未通过。
结果仅适用于已命名的规划工作流；失败的质量门阻止发布。
